product.title: OnePlus N6x
product.customers_say: Customers find the phone's appearance appealing. However, the phone receives mixed feedback about its quality and display, with some finding it great while others consider it poor. Moreover, the phone's performance is slow, taking 2.5-3 hours to charge fully, and customers report unexpected operational issues. Additionally, the camera quality is poor, and customers consider it not worth the money.

feedback_topics.name: Appearance
feedback_topics.text: Customers like the phone's appearance, with one noting it looks like a premium device.

feedback_topics.name: Quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the phone's quality, with some describing it as the best in its segment and highly recommended, while others find it to be of poor quality.

feedback_topics.name: Display quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the display quality of the phone, with one customer noting it is 720p and another mentioning poor smoothness.

feedback_topics.name: Value for money
feedback_topics.text: Customers find the phone not worth the money.

feedback_topics.name: Camera quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers are dissatisfied with the phone's camera quality, reporting poor picture clarity and performance.

feedback_topics.name: Reliability
feedback_topics.text: Customers report reliability issues with the phone, noting that it starts hanging from day one and has performance problems.

feedback_topics.name: Performance
feedback_topics.text: Customers report that the phone is very slow, taking time to process even basic actions.

feedback_topics.name: Battery life
feedback_topics.text: Customers report issues with the phone's battery life, noting that it takes a lot of time to charge and is capped at a slow 15W wired charging speed.
